text: Finite conserved energy and a repulsive Lennard-Jones singularity prevent particle collisions.
note: 有限粒子，每对势有统一下界；只陈述能量子水平集上正距离界

text: The normalized coordinates Q_i=q_i/sigma have qdot_i=sigma Qdot_i and qddot_i=sigma Qddot_i.
note: 只保留正文链式法则推导，排除argon数值参数

text: With tau=alpha t and alpha^2=epsilon/(m sigma^2), normalized LJ dynamics have unit mass and parameter-independent potential.
note: 正epsilon,m,sigma；不登记数值时间单位

text: In the fixed-center Kepler problem linear momentum is generally not conserved.
note: 非零引力给真实动量导数非零，不声称所有轨迹所有坐标导数非零

text: The harmonic action-angle coordinate pair is (I,theta).
note: 原文随后写(I,Omega)疑似笔误；独立登记正确对象与原文差异

text: For the unit LJ trimer an equilateral triangle minimizes U=3 phi_LJ(r), at r=2^(1/6).
note: 正文分析结论，排除图/模拟；全局势下界-3及等边实现

text: The unit LJ trimer cannot attain E<-3.
The collinear trimer potential is Uhat(x)=2 phi_LJ(x)+phi_LJ(2x).
The minimum in the collinear configuration is a saddle: U increases along x and decreases along y.
note: 明确局部严格不等式；原文无完整证明，不开展符号高阶计算

text: When E>0 the trimer bodies eventually escape to infinity.
note: 原文无一般逃逸证明；字面所有正能量轨道断言待人工判断
